'''Konstantin Alexandrovich Posse''' ({{langx|ru|Константин Александрович Поссе}}; September 29, 1847 – August 24, 1928) was a Russian mathematician known for contributions to [[mathematical analysis|analysis]] and in particular [[approximation theory]].<ref name=Steffens>{{cite book|doi=10.1007/0-8176-4475-X|mr=2190312|last=Steffens|first=Karl-Georg|editor1-first=George A|editor1-last=Anastassiou|title=The history of approximation theory. From Euler to Bernstein|url=https://archive.org/details/historyapproxima00stef_080|url-access=limited|publisher=Birkhäuser Boston, Inc.|location=Boston, MA|year=2006|isbn=978-0-8176-4353-9|pages=[https://archive.org/details/historyapproxima00stef_080/page/n129 114]&ndash;119}}</ref> [[Veniamin Kagan]] and [[D. D. Morduhai-Boltovskoi]] were among his students.

==Selected publications==

* {{cite journal|last=Possé|first=C.|title=Quelques remarques sur une certaine question de minimum|journal=Mathematische Annalen|doi=10.1007/BF01444256|volume=26|issue=4|pages=593&ndash;596|issn=0025-5831|jfm= 18.0325.01|year=1885|s2cid=122505974|url=https://zenodo.org/record/2147509}}
* {{cite book|last=Possé|first=C.|title=Sur quelques applications des fractions continues algébriques|url=https://archive.org/details/surquelquesappl00possgoog|jfm=18.0161.02|year=1886}}
